deciding.objective: Success rate: payments that ended captured over final payments (declines count as not captured), compared per seed on identical payment references. Revenue captured per currency is reported alongside; p95 creation-to-final latency is a guardrail (ADR-0016).

comparison.objective: Success rate: payments that ended captured over final payments (declines count as not captured), compared per seed on identical payment references. Revenue captured per currency is reported alongside; p95 creation-to-final latency is a guardrail (ADR-0016).
